degree_rationale: How the form of the word travels — through the breath, drawn by exchange, spread by tongue, cut by teeth, gathered by lips — heard by ears, like a coin engraved by five artisans circulating among men. Treats the natural mechanism of speech-and-hearing.
direction_rationale: Inward reception of how word-form is transmitted — the coin-analogy of speech being formed and received. Reflective bodily mechanism.
grand_man_function: Natural speech-reception — the inner artisan-work of word-transmission.
title: How the form of the word travels through the senses by likenesses
